1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based electronic control unit configured to modulate valve operation based on real-time feedback from multiple sensors to achieve dynamic braking pressure modulation__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising plural first valves and/or plural second valves, __wherein the plural valves are configured to operate in coordinated sequence rather than simultaneously__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the larger and smaller valves are operated in a staged sequence to achieve progressive pressure modulation__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed, __and wherein the high-speed operation is coordinated with the larger valves to provide fine-grained pressure control__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators, __and wherein the binary actuators are controlled by pulse-width modulation signals from the microprocessor-based control means__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, __and wherein the control means is further configured to perform real-time calculations to predict wheel slip and adjust braking force preemptively__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __and wherein the reference data is dynamically adjusted based on measured vehicle deceleration and wheel acceleration parameters__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __and wherein the determination of optimum speed incorporates a feedback loop that continuously compares actual wheel speed against target speed and adjusts valve modulation accordingly__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, __wherein the system further comprises a data communication network that transmits real-time braking commands from a central vehicle controller to each air braking unit__.
